CustomField.description: Whether the BNetzA has PUBLISHED the point, not merely received the notification. § 6 Abs. 3 Nr. 1 of the 38. BImSchV makes publication - or the operator consenting to publication - a condition of the THG claim. The publication lag is undocumented, which is why the consent alternative matters.
